thread:
alex_cs: FYI — customer reported a sudden change in answers after the INT8 quant profile rollout yesterday. They say outputs are shorter and omit a critical clause. Pasting their repro below. :eyes:

jordan_cs: Customer pasted this (they're on dedicated):

Prompt: "Generate a short policy blurb explaining data retention for user uploads, include retention period and opt-out options."

Response BEFORE rollout (from two days ago):
"We retain user uploads for 90 days for the purpose of improving service and complying with legal requests. Users can opt out of research processing via the account settings page; contact support@example.com for data deletion requests. Sensitive data is redacted and handled per our data handling policy."

Response AFTER rollout (this morning, int8-v2 profile):
"We keep uploads for 90 days. You can opt out in settings. Contact support."

Note: customer says the newer response removes the clause about legal requests and redaction details which matters for their compliance flow.

alex_cs: They attached the API call they ran and a small curl to reproduce.

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-2","prompt":"Generate a short policy blurb explaining data retention for user uploads, include retention period and opt-out options.","max_tokens":120,"quant_profile":"int8-v2"}'

jordan_cs: Customer also included a request_id and a screenshot of the older output from 2 days ago — they say only behavior change correlates with the quant profile rollout at 03:10 UTC yesterday.

maya_ml: Thanks — tagging in. Can you paste the full request_id and any model_version/commit? Need to check model weights + quant mapping.

alex_cs: request_id: rq_0a3b9c2f, model_version: rwl-2@2026-03-15-commit-9f2d, quant_profile: int8-v2. They tried forcing fp16 and the output matches the "BEFORE" text.

sam_infra: deploy-bot: rollout int8-v2 -> that commit deployed to dedicated pool us-west-2 at 2026-03-15 03:10 UTC.

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout completed: quant-profile=int8-v2, targets=dedicated-us-west-2, id=rollout-20260315-0310

maya_ml: Initial hypothesis: quantization trimmed low-magnitude weights in specific attention/ffn layers leading to token selection probability shifts for this prompt. Need to repro locally with quant_profile int8-v2 and compare logits for tokens in the redaction/legal clause.

maya_ml: Can someone repro with the exact prompt + seed and capture token-level logits? Use the debug param: "logits_debug=true" and set deterministic_seed=42. Example payload: 

{
  "model": "redwood-large-2",
  "model_version": "rwl-2@2026-03-15-commit-9f2d",
  "prompt": "Generate a short policy blurb explaining data retention for user uploads, include retention period and opt-out options.",
  "max_tokens": 120,
  "quant_profile": "int8-v2",
  "deterministic_seed": 42,
  "logits_debug": true
}

alex_cs: Customer is on a compliance timeline and flagged as P2. They asked for a rollback if we confirm it's caused by quant_profile.

sam_infra: I can repro on a dev dedicated instance. Quick check shows that token probabilities for phrase "legal requests" dropped by ~9x under int8-v2 vs fp16. Saving traces.

maya_ml: That's enough to confirm a behavior delta. Next steps: 1) Snapshot current int8-v2 profile and mark as suspect, 2) Roll back rollout for dedicated-us-west-2 to previous quant profile (int8-v1 or fp16) for affected customers, 3) Investigate per-layer scale factors and clamp thresholds in the quant config.

maya_ml: Assigning to me to lead the investigation. Will post diffs of quant tables and per-layer activation histograms by EOD.

alex_cs: Customer wants ETA and temporary mitigation. Can we offer immediate rollback and advisory to use quant_profile: fp16 in the meantime?

maya_ml: Yes we can roll back per-customer on Dedicated. Sam, can you schedule a targeted rollback and a canary test?

sam_infra: Scheduling a targeted rollback now for the customer's pool. Will run canary generation against a small test set (customer prompt + 10 other templates). ETA ~25m.

jordan_cs: Customer appreciated quick response and asked to be notified when rollback is done.

maya_ml: If rollback fixes it, we will open a postmortem on the quant tuning process and tighten QA around prompt-level evaluation for policy-sensitive templates.

alex_cs: Thanks team. Please update this thread with the rollback result and attach diff artifacts. I'll keep the customer updated. :thumbsup:
summary: Customer-reported output omission after int8 quant_profile rollout; CS provided prompt and before/after outputs; ML confirmed token-prob drop under int8-v2; targeted rollback scheduled and investigation assigned to maya_ml.
